_doc: Nordic Crypto crowdfunding pilot (closed, noindex). Curated by hand. Nordic Crypto never holds keys or funds: each campaign lists the project's OWN addresses. Donations, optionally with a reward the project itself describes and sells. No escrow, pooled wallets, exchange, percentage fees, all-or-nothing contracts, tokens, investments or loans. A campaign may only be added after manual checks (identity, address control by signed message, sanctions screening). Set demo:true for examples: they show a DEMO banner, invalid addresses and no progress lookup.

campaigns.title: Example campaign (demo, not live)
campaigns.description: This is a sample entry that shows how a campaign will look. It is not a real project. Do not send anything to the addresses below; they are deliberately invalid.
campaigns.reward: Optional: the project describes any reward here. The project is the seller, not Nordic Crypto.
